metadata.title: Observability, Database, and IT Service Management | SolarWinds
metadata.description: Simple, powerful, secure hybrid IT observability and IT management software built to accelerate your transformation. Start a free trial today.

notes: Full-fidelity scrape via Playwright using the real installed Google Chrome (channel: 'chrome', headless: false, navigator.webdriver patched) instead of Playwright's bundled Chromium — the site's Akamai WAF returned 'Access Denied' for the default headless Chromium fingerprint. Client (SolarWinds) approved scraping their own site for this EDS demo. cleaned.html = real #main-content DOM (script/style/noscript removed, tracking-pixel s removed, inline

images.note: Filenames derived from original CDN asset names (aprimocdn.net) and Wistia video thumbnails. Tracking-pixel/analytics images (69 total network-captured, only 36 were real content assets, 32 unique after dedup) were discarded. Images matched into cleaned.html by origin+pathname (ignoring resize query params) since the rendered DOM's img[src] often differs in query string from whichever srcset variant the browser actually fetched.
